item.description:
✨ Your student's future is full of possibilities, and we're here to help you explore them! Join us for Explore Arlington ISD, your one-stop shop to learn about the district's Signature Programs and the unique opportunities available for students to pursue their passions!
📆 Wednesday, Oct. 21 ⌚ 6–7:30 p.m. 📍 Dan Dipert Career + Technical Center
Whether your student is interested in academics, career pathways, or specialized learning experiences, this is the perfect opportunity to discover what's available and find the right fit! https://www.aisd.net/signature-programs/ www.aisd.net/signature-programs/
